definitions.ask: Should `=` flip direction anywhere in a relation picker's filter, exactly like `~` does?
definitions.why: It mirrors the `~` contract you asked to copy, and relation searches almost never need `=`.

choices.label: `=` flips at any filter text, like `~`; a relation filter can no longer contain a typed `=`
`=` flips only while the filter is empty; after a typed query, `=` enters the filter as text
